segments.he: הרה"צ ר' דוב בער בן הרב הצדיק ר' שניאור זלמן הרב מלאדי אמר על מוהרנ"ת ז"ל שהוא עלוי בחסידות:
segments.en: The last time Reb Avraham was in Uman — the World War had then broken out. He devised all manner of schemes to cross the border secretly in order to return to Eretz Yisroel. He was very bitter and distressed — and cried out at the holy grave: "Rebbe — you have the power to lie in the Diaspora — but I must lie in Eretz Yisroel!" He was very embittered over the time — the year 5675 in Gematria is tzaros [troubles], G-d preserve us. And he always prayed for all of Yisroel — almost all his prayer was for the community. He cried out: "How much blood is being spilled — are these not the free-thinkers who are so guilty? They are like a child taken captive — and His mercy is upon all His works — let sinners cease rather than sin." And so he was always doing great advocacy on behalf of all of Yisroel whose name Israel is upon them.
